citation: Wiecek M, et al. Front Physiol 2018;9:1782
protocol: Single 20 s all-out cycle sprint (load 0.075 x body mass in men, 0.065 x BM in women), morning, 2 h after a light breakfast; blood at 0, 3, 15, 30, 60 min and 24 h
population: 10 healthy men (21.6 +/- 1.2 y, BMI 23.7) and 10 healthy women (22.6 +/- 1.5 y, BMI 21.5)
note: Sex-split glucose and lactate at six times after one sprint; glucose changes are small and mostly not significant; table lists SD (some medians in the baseline table).
